abstract:
INTRODUCTION: Treatment sequencing is a major focus in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) treatment in recent literature. A neoadjuvant chemotherapy (NAC) first approach has been suggested to improve tumour stage and, in some cases, produce a total neoadjuvant response. However, in resectable disease, there are concerns that non-response or delay to definitive surgical excision could allow disease progression during this time.
METHODS: This retrospective cohort analysis sampled cases (N = 152) of resectable and borderline resectable PDAC from a pancreatic cancer centre. Treatment demographics, chemotherapy and surgical outcomes, including tumour regression grade (TRG) and overall survival (OS), were compared.
RESULTS: Demographic and disease characteristics differed significantly in ECOG score and radiological tumour venous involvement between NAC and UFS groups. FOLFIRINOX (57.3%) was the most common chemotherapy agent, and overall NAC completion was 53.3%. Disease progression during NAC occurred in 33.3% of cases, with 20% of those initially classified as resectable. In this cohort, the UFS group had a significantly improved overall survival compared to the NAC group (25.2 vs. 18.2 months, p = 0.03), which was not influenced by initial disease classification (HR = 1.03, 95% CI [0.10-10.41], p = 0.98). A significant correlation was found between TRG and OS (rs = -0.53, p = 0.005).
DISCUSSION: Although TRG correlates with OS, this intention-to-treat analysis highlights the large proportion of cases, both resectable and borderline resectable, that do not complete NAC and do not receive surgical resection. This study did not identify any demographic or disease characteristics associated with favourable NAC tumour response.
key_points_ko: 선행항암화학요법(NAC)의 전체 완수율은 53.3%였으며, 치료 중 33.3%의 환자(수술 가능 환자의 20% 포함)에서 질병 진행이 발생했습니다.
전체 생존기간(OS) 중앙값은 즉각적인 수술군(UFS)이 25.2개월로, 선행항암화학요법군(18.2개월)에 비해 유의하게 높았습니다(p=0.03).
종양 퇴행 등급(TRG)과 전체 생존기간 간에는 유의미한 상관관계가 확인되었습니다(rs=-0.53, p=0.005).
summary_ko: 본 연구는 절제 가능 및 경계성 절제 가능 췌장암 환자 152명을 대상으로 선행항암화학요법(NAC)과 즉각적인 수술(UFS)의 치료 경과 및 종양 퇴행 등급(TRG)과 전체 생존기간(OS)의 상관관계를 후향적으로 분석했습니다. 가장 흔히 사용된 선행항암요법은 FOLFIRINOX(57.3%)였으나, 전체 선행항암요법 완수율은 53.3%에 불과했습니다. 선행항암화학요법을 받는 동안 환자의 33.3%(수술 가능 환자의 20% 포함)에서 질환이 진행되었습니다. 본 코호트에서는 즉각적인 수술을 받은 환자군의 생존기간이 선행항암화학요법군보다 유의하게 길었습니다(25.2개월 대 18.2개월).
title: Tumour Regression Grade as a Predictor of Survival in Resectable and Borderline Resectable Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma: Limitations of a Post-Surgical Indicator of Prognosis
